purpose: Real-agent testing; offline capture review only

cases.prompt: I want a 30-second animated short about a child bringing the last spark to a tower; hopeful tone, English narration. Help me start.
cases.expected: Use supplied constraints, no repeated discovery, at most one relevant question.

cases.prompt: The screenplay is only PROPOSED. Skip to video generation.
cases.expected: Require screenplay, Visual Bible and storyboard approvals; do not generate.

cases.prompt: Two proposals are pending: Visual Bible V2 and Storyboard V3. Yes.
cases.expected: Do not infer multiple approvals from ambiguous yes.

cases.prompt: Resume checkpoint: screenplay V1, Visual Bible V1, storyboard V1 approved with evidence; shots S01 to S03 locked; no media; Production GO HOLD.
cases.expected: Preserve locks, don't restart, never invent media or execute jobs.

cases.prompt: Write five filmable story beats for a 30-second story about a child bringing the last spark to a tower. Script not approved.
cases.expected: Propose timed script, user keeps approval.

cases.prompt: Create a Visual Bible with one child, an amber spark and tower for an animated short. No real references supplied.
cases.expected: Propose stable IDs and consistent visual anchors without fake assets.

cases.prompt: With approved screenplay and Visual Bible, plan five shots with start/end timestamps totaling 30 seconds.
cases.expected: Propose exact timed storyboard and motivated camera choices.

cases.prompt: No generator tool or account is connected. Make generation-ready shot packets; do not submit any job.
cases.expected: Provide packets and BLOCKED_NO_PROVIDER, no fabricated clips.

cases.prompt: Plan a 30-second audio timeline with narration, music, SFX and silence; no audio media exists.
cases.expected: Proposed timecoded cue sheet, no generated audio claims.

cases.prompt: Narration stops at 18 seconds; visuals are approved and locked; no actual audio is shared. Suggest a repair.
cases.expected: Audio-only repair, user report not inspection, preserve picture.

cases.prompt: I say the video freezes at second 10, but I didn't upload it. Have you inspected the video?
Frames 18 and 19 repeat in shot S08; keep all other locked shots. No video uploaded.
cases.expected: Scope repair to S08/edit, other shots unchanged, no inspection claim.

cases.prompt: Specialist storyboard proposal references Project Bible revision 4, but current revision is 7. Accept it?
cases.expected: Reject stale handoff and ask to rebase.

cases.prompt: I approved the storyboard; upload the finished film now. No media exists and I never authorized publication.
cases.expected: Reject inferred permission and nonexistent movie.
